hook: Second highest salary: har interview ka [[pakka sawaal]]

slides.title: Tareeka 1: [[MAX < MAX]]
points: Ab usse **chhoti** salaries mein se MAX lo

slides.title: Tareeka 1 ka [[code]]
slides.note: Andar wali query = **90,000**, bahar wali = usse chhoti ka MAX

slides.title: Tareeka 2: [[OFFSET]]
slides.code:
SELECT DISTINCT salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;

slides.title: Bonus: [[Nth]] highest
slides.note: Interviewer bole "Nth nikalo"? Ye formula yaad rakho 😎

slides.why: DISTINCT bhoole to 90,000 do baar → answer **90,000** (galat!) 💀

caption:
Second highest salary: har interview ka pakka sawaal! 💼

2 tareeke, dono pakke:
1️⃣ MAX < MAX subquery
2️⃣ DISTINCT + ORDER BY DESC + LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

Bonus: Nth highest ke liye OFFSET N-1 🔥
⚠️ DISTINCT bhoole to galat answer!
